purpose: Teach: 凶悪/両論/貫い/逃走/生き延び/芽生え/すれ違い/院生

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、凶悪な競争、本格化しているな。
lines.en: The competition in this industry is getting ruthless.
lines.style: Measured, observational. Opens with steady authority. Even pace. Not alarmed—this is fact-noting. Eyes level, assessing the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、新方針に賛否両論、出ています。
lines.en: Yes. We're getting mixed reactions to the new direction internally.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Matches his tempo. No flourish—clean delivery of the point. A half-step behind, supporting his thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者は、ぶれずに信念を貫いた人物だった。
lines.en: The founder was the kind of person who never wavered in what he believed.
lines.style: Reflective, almost paternal. A slight drop in pace—drawing a through-line. Steady conviction in the voice, not defensive. Looking inward first, then out.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。元社員、競合に逃走するケース、増えております。
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing more cases of staff leaving for our competitors.
lines.style: Factual report, slight edge of concern underneath. Steady tempo. Not dramatizing—just laying the problem where he can see it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 我が社は、何度も生き延びてきた、底力がある。
lines.en: Our company has survived hard times before. We have that core strength.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slower than before—the weight of history in it. Not pep-talk, not doubt. The voice of someone who's watched the pattern before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新たな企業文化、芽生え始めています、若手中心に。
lines.en: Yes. A new company culture is starting to take root, especially among the younger staff.
lines.style: Supportive observation. Slight warmth entering—not quite optimism, but recognition. Tempo picks up fractionally. Affirming what he's said.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部門間のすれ違い、コミュニケーション、強化しろ。
lines.en: Strengthen communication between the departments. The gaps are growing.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Clean, final-sounding. The instruction lands with quiet weight. No theatrics—this is what needs to happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。院生インターンも、有望な人材、増えました。
lines.en: Yes. We've also been getting more promising graduate interns recently.
lines.style: Closing note of hope. Light lift on the word 'promising'—a small gift he's offering. Warm but not effusive. Closing the meeting on forward movement.
